     from alternative_assets.yardi_holdings
     where  business_date = (select max(business_date) from alternative_assets.yardi_holdings
      where business_date <= date'2025-06-10')

     on a.id_model_portfolio = b.id_instrument_alternate

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 11
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-11 13:46:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

),

	SELECT FACT.analytic_value AS pv
	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_uat.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact,
		risk_uat.dim_chron c,
		risk_uat.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node
	WHERE FACT.CHRON_ID = c.CHRON_ID

		AND fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
		AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
		AND FACT.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
		AND node.node_level = 1
),
ACPP_PV AS (
	SELECT f.analytic_value AS pv
	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_uat.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
		JOIN risk_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
	WHERE f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
		AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'

		AND h.ACCOUNT = 'ACPP'
		AND h.node_level = 2
),
BCPP_PV AS (
	SELECT f.analytic_value AS pv

		JOIN risk_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID

		AND h.ACCOUNT = 'BCPP'
		AND h.node_level = 2

		AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		/* Exclude all north american government positions */
		AND NOT (
			(

			)
			AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
		)
	GROUP BY PARENT.party_name

		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 11
		AND hour between 15 and 16
	)

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE

		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')

		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

	client_ip

        ss.bus_date

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si1
        ON ss.sedol = si1.sedol
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si2

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si3

                      SPLIT_PART(node_path, '|',4) AS Strategy_SA,
                      SPLIT_PART(node_path, '|',5) AS program_SA, 
                      SPLIT_PART(node_path, '|',13) AS MP_SA from risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node where business_date >= '2025-04-01' and hierarchy_type in ('SA') and node_level=12) dh 
ON pos.scd_model_portfolio = dh.MP_SA and pos.business_date = dh.sa_business_date
where pos.business_date >= '2025-04-01' and program_SA IN ('Excess Liquidity Deployment','Collateral Optimization','Financing') AND MP_SA NOT IN (select MP from ellm_mp_exclude)) AS "New custom SQL"
WHERE date_trunc('day', CAST(CAST(PARSE_DATETIME("business_date", 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) = date_trunc('day', CAST(CAST(PARSE_DATETIME('2025-06-10 00:00:00', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) AND "scd_model_portfolio" IN ('CLG3', 'IPCMTNS') AND "product_type" IN ('Interest Rate Swap', 'Medium term debt') AND CASE WHEN "position_description" like '%Float%' AND "product_type" = 'Medium term debt' THEN 'Floating' ELSE 'Fixed' END IN ('Fixed')

	    from radar_reporting_uat.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact
	    join radar_reporting_uat.dim_chron c on fact.chron_id = c.chron_id
	    join radar_reporting_uat.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node on fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID and fact.chron_id = node.chron_id
	    where
		  c.business_date = '2025-06-10'
	      AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
	      AND fact.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
	      AND node.node_level = 1
		  AND node.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
		  and c.canonical_source = '1'
	  ),
	category_limits as
	  (
	    select 'FI' as category, pv * 0.3 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BBB' as category, pv * 0.0625 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BB' as category, pv * 0.0525 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select '<= B' as category, pv * 0.0425 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	  ),
	WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI as
	  (

          parent.party_name,

	    select fact.analytic_value as pv
	    from radar_reporting_uat.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact
	    join radar_reporting_uat.dim_chron c on fact.chron_id = c.chron_id
	    join radar_reporting_uat.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node on fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID and fact.chron_id = node.chron_id
	    where
		  c.business_date = '2025-06-10'
	      AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
	      AND fact.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
	      AND node.node_level = 1
		  AND node.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
		  and c.canonical_source = '1'
	  ),
	category_limits as
	  (
	    select 'FI' as category, pv * 0.3 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BBB' as category, pv * 0.0625 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BB' as category, pv * 0.0525 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select '<= B' as category, pv * 0.0425 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	  ),
	WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI as
	  (
	    select
          parent.party_name,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and parent.gics_sector = 'Financials' then credit_exposure else 0 end) as fi_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as bbb_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^BB[\+\-]?$' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as bb_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as b_or_below_ce
        from
		  radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
          radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
		  radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
        where fact.business_date = '2025-06-10'
          and fact.business_date = child.business_date
          and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
          AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		  AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
          AND NOT ( (parent.is_government = 'Y' OR parent.is_provincial = 'Y' ) AND parent.domicile_country_code in ('US', 'CA') )
        group by parent.party_name
	  ),
	  summary_ce as 
	  (
	  select *
	    from
	      (
	        select
	          v.*,
	           sum(fi_ce) over () as sum_fi_ce,
               sum(bbb_ce) over () as sum_bbb_ce,
               sum(bb_ce) over () as sum_bb_ce,
               sum(b_or_below_ce) over () as sum_b_or_below_ce,
               row_number() over ( order by fi_ce desc ) as fi_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by bbb_ce desc ) as bbb_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by bb_ce desc ) as bb_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by b_or_below_ce desc ) as b_or_below_ce_rank
	        from WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI v
	      )
	      CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
	        array['FI', 'BBB', 'BB', '<=B'], array[fi_ce, bbb_ce, bb_ce, b_or_below_ce], array[sum_fi_ce, sum_bbb_ce, sum_bb_ce, sum_b_or_below_ce], array[fi_ce_rank, bbb_ce_rank, bb_ce_rank, b_or_below_ce_rank]
	      ) as t(category, top_exposure, total_exposure, rank)
	     where rank = 1
	     )
	     select
	  ce.category,
	  total_exposure / 1000000 AS total_exposure,
	  limit / 1000000 AS limit,
	  ROUND( total_exposure / limit * 100, 1) AS limit_util,
	  case
	    WHEN limit IS NULL OR limit >= total_exposure THEN 'OK'
	    ELSE 'BREACH'
	  END AS status,
	  party_name AS top_issuer_name,
	  top_exposure / 1000000 AS top_exposure
	FROM summary_ce ce, category_limits cl
	WHERE ce.category = cl.category and limit IS NOT NULL AND limit < total_exposure
	order by case WHEN ce.category = 'FI' THEN 1 WHEN ce.category = 'BBB' THEN 2 WHEN ce.category = 'BB' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

/* cppi::3c30780955c4ab1c1ee9bd0bfd0fc7b924b93aff9560bdb64b163c219d265f41 */
SELECT from_currency as from_currency, 
    ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
    format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' 
and business_date>=DATE '2000-01-01'
UNION
SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
    ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
    format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
Left Join ( 
    SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
    FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
) as CAD_Rate on MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
WHERE MainTable.from_currency = 'USD' and MainTable.mid_price != 0 and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
and MainTable.business_date>=DATE '2000-01-01'
order by business_date, from_currency

                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then 0

SELECT "business_date", "node_name", "metric_name", "period", "department_name", "value", "year_month", "formatted_year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (select distinct
	  roc.business_date
	, replace( roc.node_name, ' (P)', '' ) as node_name
	, roc.metric_name
	, roc.period
	, invstr.parent_node_name as department_name
	, roc.value
	, date_format( roc.business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
	, date_format( roc.business_date, '%b %Y' ) as formatted_year_month
	, case
		when roc.period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
		when roc.period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
		when roc.period = 'FYTD' then '3. FYTD'
		when roc.period = '1Y rolling' then '4. 1Y'
		when roc.period = '4Y+' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
		when roc.period = '5Y rolling' then '6. 5Y'
		else roc.period
	  end as period_sorted
from
	performance.ars_performance_metric roc
join performance.scd_performance_invstr invstr
on
	roc.node_name = invstr.node_name) AS "finsights_perf_returns_roc"

    group by limit_name,

    union all

SELECT SUM(1) AS "COL"
FROM (
  with var_10yr as (
  	select node_level,
  		node,
  		department,
  		strategy,
  		program,
  		sub_program,
  		model_portfolio,
  		analytic_value,
  		business_date,
  		analytic_type,
  		to_date(business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as source_business_date,
  		'' as position_key
  	from risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  	where analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR'
  		and hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
  		and confidence_level = 0.95
  ),
  vol_10yr as (
  	select node_level,
  		node,
  		department,
  		strategy,
  		program,
  		sub_program,
  		model_portfolio,
  		analytic_value,
  		business_date,
  		analytic_type,
  		to_date(business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as source_business_date,
  		'' as position_key
  	from risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  	where analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
  		and hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
  ),
  exp_shrt_1yr as (
  	select node_level,
  		node,
  		department,
  		strategy,
  		program,
  		sub_program,
  		model_portfolio,
  		analytic_value,
  		business_date,
  		analytic_type,
  		to_date(business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as source_business_date,
  		'' as position_key
  	from risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  	where analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_1YR'
  		and hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
  		and confidence_level = 0.95
  ),
  rm_pv as (
  	select node_level,
  		node,
  		department,
  		strategy,
  		program,
  		sub_program,
  		model_portfolio,
  		analytic_value,
  		business_date,
  		'RM_PV' as analytic_type,
  		to_date(business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as source_business_date,
  		'' as position_key
  	from risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  	where analytic_type = 'PV'
  		and hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
  ),
  radar_pv as (
  	select node_level,
  		node,
  		department,
  		strategy,
  		program,
  		sub_program,
  		model_portfolio,
  		analytic_value,
  		business_date,
  		'RADAR_PV' as analytic_type,
  		to_date(business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as source_business_date,
  		'' as position_key
  	from risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  	where analytic_type = 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_PV'
  		and hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
  ),
  src as (
  	select *
  	from var_10yr
  	union all
  	select *
  	from vol_10yr
  	union all
  	select *
  	from exp_shrt_1yr
  	union all
  	select *
  	from rm_pv
  	union all
  	select *
  	from radar_pv
  )
  select *
  from src

HAVING COUNT(1)>0

select
   (select min(cash_flow_payment_date) 
   from trades_deals.ccrscashflow_trades c
      where c.business_date = t.business_date
      and c.trade_id = t.trade_id
      and c.leg_type = t.leg_type_1
    ) leg1_first_coup_date,
   (select min(cash_flow_payment_date) 
   from trades_deals.ccrscashflow_trades c 
      where c.business_date = t.business_date
      and c.trade_id = t.trade_id
      and c.leg_type = t.leg_type_2
    ) leg2_first_coup_date,
     t. *,
     t.current_nominal * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as current_nominal_pc,
     t.market_value as clean_market_value,
     t.market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as clean_market_value_pc,
     t.market_value as market_value_mv,
     t.market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as market_value_base_mv,
     p.party_name,
     p.domicile_country_code,
     p.incorp_country_code,
     p.bloomberg_company_id,
     m.id_model_portfolio,
     s.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code pool_code
from trades_deals.ccrs_trades t
left join party.party p 
     on p.cppib_party_id = cast(t.id_counterparty as int)
     and p.business_date = t.business_date
left join finance_accounting.murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping m
     on m.trading_portfolio_code = t.trading_portfolio_code
     and m.business_date = t.business_date
left join finance_accounting.model_portfolios s
     on (s.id_model_portfolio = m.id_model_portfolio or s.id_model_portfolio = t.trading_portfolio_code)
     and s.business_date = t.business_date
where t.business_date = cast('2025-06-10' as date)

   (select min(cash_flow_payment_date) 
   from trades_deals.ccrscashflow_trades c 
      where c.business_date = t.business_date
      and c.trade_id = t.trade_id
      and c.leg_type = t.leg_type_2
    ) leg2_first_coup_date,
     t. *,
     t.current_nominal * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as current_nominal_pc,
     t.market_value as clean_market_value,
     t.market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as clean_market_value_pc,
     t.market_value as market_value_mv,
     t.market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as market_value_base_mv,
     p.party_name,
     p.domicile_country_code,
     p.incorp_country_code,
     p.bloomberg_company_id,
     m.id_model_portfolio,
     s.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code pool_code
from trades_deals.ccrs_trades t
left join party.party p 
     on p.cppib_party_id = cast(t.id_counterparty as int)
     and p.business_date = t.business_date
left join finance_accounting.murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping m
     on m.trading_portfolio_code = t.trading_portfolio_code
     and m.business_date = t.business_date
left join finance_accounting.model_portfolios s
     on (s.id_model_portfolio = m.id_model_portfolio or s.id_model_portfolio = t.trading_portfolio_code)
     and s.business_date = t.business_date
where t.business_date = cast('2025-06-10' as date)
